name: Kansas
agency: Kansas Department of Wildlife and Parks

rule.textEn: Anyone born on or after Jan. 1, 1989 who is under 21 needs a boater safety education certificate to run a motorboat or sailboat, unless supervised by a qualified person over 17.
rule.textEs: Quien nació el 1 de enero de 1989 o después y tiene menos de 21 años necesita un certificado de educación náutica para manejar una lancha o un velero, salvo que lo supervise una persona habilitada mayor de 17 años.

exemptions: Under the direct and audible supervision of a person over 17 who holds a certificate or is exempt.
Non-motorized sailboat 16 ft 7 in or shorter during an instructor-led class.

sources.publisher: Kansas Office of Revisor of Statutes (K.S.A. 32-1139)
sources.quote: No person born on or after January 1, 1989, shall operate on public waters of this state any motorboat or sailboat unless the person possesses a certificate of completion of an approved boater safety education course

sources.publisher: Kansas Office of Revisor of Statutes (K.S.A. 32-1139)
sources.quote: The requirement in subsection (a)(1), shall not apply to a person 21 years of age or older.
